title: wui.json
description: Configuration for the wui CLI — where components land and which registries to pull them from.

style.description: The component style variant to pull.

rsc.description: Whether the project uses React Server Components.

tsx.description: Whether components are written as .tsx (false emits .jsx).

css.description: Path to the stylesheet that registry CSS variables are merged into.

baseColor.description: Base color ramp used to generate theme tokens.

cssVariables.description: Theme via CSS variables rather than hard-coded utility classes.

aliases.description: Import aliases that determine where each kind of file is written. Resolved against the `@/*` path in tsconfig.json, falling back to src/ then the project root.

registries.description: Namespace -> URL template. `{name}` is replaced with the component name, so `@wui/button` resolves against the `@wui` entry.
